player_prompt.intro:
Ndinewe ku Etale Ekaladhi!

Ove orepresentado kwa 'P' mbanja ya grid.
Simbolu za grid:
  ' ' = Etale ekaladhi (olifeka okutemuka)
  'H' = Ombala (okukwata mwenyo, ofa!)
  'G' = Etumbo (kufikila hili, ovinge!)
  'P' = Posição yawe yamene

Mikwamo inawilable: kwaari, kushuka, kwenda kushoto, kwenda kulia (kana w, a, s, d)
Tayipa ação yawe kama: [up], [down], [left], [right] kana [w], [a], [s], [d]

Objetivo: Navijaruka kwaari kwa ntandu (shoka-kushoto) mpaka etumbo (shoka-kulia) upwe okukwata mwenyo mombala!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ovimbundi vya kuza si vya mboyo. Tanga [up], [down], [left], [right] kana [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Oku linga upange umue ka wa kũlĩhĩwile '{action}'. Kuama up, down, left, right ale w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Okanisa kukwata {action} lakini ukakutana na ukingo!

outcome.fell_in_hole: We ulungwa kuvingila mombala! Ove mwene wa kupwa. We ulungwa kukamilisha {pct}% ya safari kufikila ondjokonona.
outcome.turn_limit: We ulungwa kufikila mwene wa kupindukila! Ove mwene wa kupwa. We ulungwa kukamilisha {pct}% ya safari kufikila ondjokonona.
